description: Add an explicit generation and granted-owner token to lock, replay, unlock, live push, and delayed replies; reject same-generation foreign owners and old tasks before WAL mutation. Preserve task-based replay callers. Negative real-WAL histories cover stale replay, push, unlock, queued requests, duplicate owner, and delayed replies. No legacy unfenced fallback; compatible-binary-only upgrade. Dependency of bedrock-t0k.

comments.text: GitHub issue: https://github.com/bedrock-kv/bedrock/issues/297. Split from GH259; depends on bedrock-7i1 and remains blocked until its ownership token is defined.

title: Fence Shale replay and live pushes with recovery ownership tokens
